According to Vice Cit, Cyberleek invested about $29,000 into creating the coin.
Vice Cit suggests they probably made about $30,000 on fees on the first day of the leak, essentially making back what they put in, and since then have been getting several thousand per day.

The creator also apparently has 270 million tokens set aside in an additional, private wallet that was worth about $391k at the time of Vice Cit’s post, which could conceivably be sold off for profit as well.
